name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
target: Micro enterprises and individuals seeking credit for income-generating activities
purpose: Provides institutional credit for micro enterprises.
benefit: Credit support through participating lending institutions.
important_note: Loan approval, interest rate and repayment terms depend on the lending institution and applicable rules.
source: Department of Financial Services, Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
target: Eligible landholding farmer families
purpose: Provides income support to eligible farmer families.
benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments, subject to eligibility and exclusions.
important_note: Eligibility and exclusion rules must be checked before recommending the scheme.
source: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission
target: Rural households, including members of Self Help Groups
purpose: Supports rural livelihoods, financial inclusion and community institutions.
benefit: Support for SHG formation, financial inclusion and livelihoods.
important_note: Implementation involves State Rural Livelihood Missions and local institutions.
source: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises
target: Eligible micro food-processing enterprises and eligible SHGs and groups
purpose: Supports formalisation and upgrading of micro food-processing enterprises.
benefit: Support can include credit-linked capital subsidy and other assistance under applicable components.
important_note: Eligibility and support depend on the applicable PMFME component.
source: Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Government of India

name: PM Vishwakarma
target: Eligible artisans and craftspeople working in specified traditional trades
purpose: Provides support to eligible traditional artisans and craftspeople.
benefit: Support includes recognition, skill training, toolkit assistance, credit support, digital incentives and marketing support under scheme rules.
important_note: The scheme has specified eligible trades and eligibility conditions.
source: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
target: Eligible entrepreneurs establishing new micro enterprises
purpose: Promotes employment through new self-employment ventures and micro enterprises.
benefit: Margin-money subsidy and bank-linked project financing subject to scheme rules.
important_note: Project eligibility, contribution, subsidy and bank finance depend on current PMEGP guidelines.
source: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
target: Eligible street vendors
purpose: Provides credit and support for street vendors.
benefit: Working-capital credit and incentives for digital transactions under applicable rules.
important_note: Eligibility, loan tranches and incentives must be checked against current scheme rules.
source: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India

name: Kisan Credit Card
target: Eligible farmers and eligible agricultural and allied-activity borrowers
purpose: Provides timely credit for cultivation and specified agricultural and allied needs.
benefit: Credit support for eligible cultivation, post-harvest and allied activities.
important_note: Loan limits, interest and eligibility depend on current rules and bank implementation.
source: Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan
target: Eligible farmers and other eligible entities under applicable scheme components
purpose: Promotes solar energy in agriculture.
benefit: Support for eligible solar pumps, solarisation and renewable-energy projects under applicable components.
important_note: State-level implementation and component-specific eligibility apply.
source: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
target: Eligible rural households
purpose: Provides housing assistance to eligible rural households.
benefit: Housing assistance subject to current PMAY-G eligibility and implementation rules.
important_note: Beneficiary selection and eligibility require verification.
source: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
target: People seeking access to basic banking and financial services
purpose: Promotes access to banking, savings, remittance, credit, insurance and pension services.
benefit: Basic banking access and connection to eligible financial services.
important_note: Specific benefits are subject to applicable conditions.
source: Department of Financial Services, Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
target: Eligible bank account holders in the applicable age group
purpose: Provides renewable life insurance coverage.
benefit: Life insurance cover subject to current scheme terms.
important_note: Current premium, age eligibility and enrolment conditions must be verified.
source: Department of Financial Services, Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
target: Eligible bank or post-office account holders in the applicable age group
purpose: Provides renewable personal accident insurance.
benefit: Accident insurance coverage subject to current scheme terms.
important_note: Current premium and eligibility conditions must be verified.
source: Department of Financial Services, Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
target: Eligible people seeking skill development and training
purpose: Provides skill development, upskilling and reskilling opportunities.
benefit: Training and related skill-development support under applicable components.
important_note: Available courses and eligibility depend on the current implementation.
source: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
target: Eligible residential electricity consumers
purpose: Supports residential rooftop solar installations.
benefit: Central financial assistance for eligible residential rooftop solar installations.
important_note: Eligibility, subsidy and installation requirements depend on current guidelines.
source: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Government of India

name: Maha Lakshmi Scheme
target: Eligible women and households in Telangana under applicable conditions
purpose: Women-focused welfare support.
benefit: The Telangana State Portal describes financial assistance for eligible women who are heads of families, subsidised LPG cylinders and free TSRTC bus travel.
important_note: Eligibility and implementation conditions must be verified through current Telangana government guidelines.
source: Government of Telangana

name: Indira Mahila Shakti
target: Women members of Self Help Groups in Telangana
purpose: Strengthens women SHGs and supports livelihoods and enterprise development.
benefit: Activities include livelihood development, skill development, branding, packaging, marketing, processing centres, enterprise support and financial linkages.
important_note: Specific support depends on the applicable Telangana SHG programme and local implementation.
source: Society for Elimination of Rural Poverty, Government of Telangana

name: Rythu Bharosa
target: Eligible agricultural beneficiaries in Telangana
purpose: Provides agricultural financial support.
benefit: Financial assistance intended to support farmers during crop cycles.
important_note: Current beneficiary categories and amount must be verified from the official Rythu Bharosa system.
source: Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana

name: Gruha Jyothi
target: Eligible Telangana households
purpose: Reduces electricity expenses for eligible households.
benefit: Eligible households consuming up to 200 units per month can receive zero electricity bills under the scheme.
important_note: Eligibility and household conditions must be checked.
source: Government of Telangana

name: Indiramma Indlu
target: Eligible Telangana households requiring housing assistance
purpose: Provides housing assistance to eligible households.
benefit: Financial assistance for eligible house construction under applicable government guidelines.
important_note: Beneficiary selection and assistance must be verified through current Telangana housing authorities.
source: Government of Telangana

name: Cheyutha / Rajiv Aarogyasri
target: Eligible economically vulnerable families in Telangana
purpose: Provides healthcare and financial protection for eligible medical treatment.
benefit: The Telangana State Portal describes healthcare coverage under Rajiv Aarogyasri for eligible families.
important_note: Coverage, eligibility and empanelled hospitals must be checked using current guidelines.
source: Government of Telangana

name: Aasara Pensions
target: Eligible vulnerable residents of Telangana
purpose: Provides social-security assistance through pensions.
benefit: Pension support according to the applicable Telangana category.
important_note: Eligibility and pension amount vary by category and current government rules.
source: Government of Telangana

name: Rajiv Yuva Vikasam
target: Eligible unemployed youth under the applicable Telangana categories
purpose: Supports self-employment and income-generating activities.
benefit: Financial assistance for eligible self-employment or enterprise activities.
important_note: Age, category, income, project and other conditions must be checked.
source: Government of Telangana

name: Telangana Crop Loan Waiver
target: Eligible agricultural borrowers covered by current Telangana rules
purpose: Provides debt relief for eligible agricultural crop loans.
benefit: Loan waiver support for eligible loans covered by the applicable programme.
important_note: Loan date, borrower, bank, loan type and other conditions must be verified.
source: Government of Telangana

name: Dalit Bandhu
target: Eligible SC households under Telangana government guidelines
purpose: Supports income-generating economic activities.
benefit: Economic assistance for eligible beneficiaries under applicable scheme rules.
important_note: Beneficiary selection and current implementation conditions must be verified.
source: Government of Telangana
